prompt:
You are an expert software engineer specialized in design patterns. You will be given a poorly written Python code.
Your task is to identify which design patterns from the following list should be applied to refactor and improve it: [abstract_factory, factory_method, builder, command, strategy, template_method, state, proxy, decorator, adapter]

Rules: (1) Output ALL patterns that would concretely improve this code, without artificial limits. (2) A pattern is applicable if the code structure suggests it, even in a partial or non-canonical form. (3) Names must be exactly as in the list above (case-sensitive). (4) There is at least one applicable pattern: always output at least one. (5) Order the list from most to least recommended.
label: base + role + rules
